ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners files a memo seeking withdrawal of the Criminal Petition.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"The Petitioners in the above case with "NOC" filed fresh Vakalath from Advocate Sri.N.K.Nanjundagowda.
It is NC: 2026:KHC:5875 HC-KAR prayed that this Hon'ble court be pleased to permit the Petitioners to withdraw the above case and shall be continued trial court.
Hence, this memo may be taken on record in the interest of justice."
In terms of memo, the Criminal Petition is disposed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
